papers.title: dcHiChIP: A comprehensive Nextflow-based pipeline for multiscale analysis of chromatin architecture from HiChIP data.
papers.authors: Agarwal, Abhishek; Al Bkhetan, Ziad; Plewczynski, Dariusz
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文介绍了一个用于HiChIP数据染色质架构分析的流程，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联，但可能为相关研究提供技术参考。
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Despite the growing use of HiChIP to investigate protein-directed chromatin architecture, a comprehensive and reproducible pipeline for analyzing these datasets-from raw reads to multiscale 3D genome features-remains lacking. Existing tools often focus on isolated components, such as loop calling or matrix generation, but fall short in integrating structural annotation, functional enrichment, and spatial modeling within a unified framework. To address this gap, we developed dcHiChIP, a modular, scalable Nextflow-based workflow that streamlines the analysis of HiChIP data, enabling both routine processing and in-depth exploration of chromatin organization and regulatory interactions. RESULTS: dcHiChIP enables robust and reproducible analysis of HiChIP datasets across multiple scales of chromatin architecture. It accepts raw sequencing data as input and generates high-quality loop calls, domain annotations, and 3D genome models. It also performs functional annotation and motif enrichment analyses. Applied to benchmark CTCF HiChIP datasets, dcHiChIP identifies major chromatin architectural features such as TADs/CCDs, A/B compartments, and chromatin stripes, and offers efficient, end-to-end execution with support for batch processing and workflow resumability. AVAILABILITY: dcHiChIP is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/SFGLab/dcHiChIP, with documentation at https://sfglab.github.io/dcHiChIP/. The software version used in this study is archived at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22030542. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
papers.abstract_zh: 动机：尽管HiChIP在探究蛋白质导向的染色质结构中的应用日益增多，但目前仍缺乏一个全面且可重复的流程，用于分析这些数据集——从原始读段到多尺度3D基因组特征。现有工具通常聚焦于孤立组件，如环检测或矩阵生成，但未能将结构注释、功能富集和空间建模整合到一个统一框架中。为填补这一空白，我们开发了dcHiChIP，这是一个模块化、可扩展的基于Nextflow的工作流程，可简化HiChIP数据的分析，支持常规处理以及对染色质组织和调控相互作用的深入探索。结果：dcHiChIP能够在染色质架构的多尺度上对HiChIP数据集进行稳健且可重复的分析。它接受原始测序数据作为输入，并生成高质量的环检测、结构域注释和3D基因组模型。它还执行功能注释和基序富集分析。应用于基准CTCF HiChIP数据集时，dcHiChIP识别出主要的染色质结构特征，如TADs/CCDs、A/B compartments和染色质条纹，并提供高效、端到端的执行，支持批量处理和工作流可恢复性。可用性：dcHiChIP在GitHub上公开可用，网址为https://github.com/SFGLab/dcHiChIP，文档位于https://sfglab.github.io/dcHiChIP/。本研究中使用的软件版本已存档于Zenodo：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22030542。补充信息：补充数据可在Bioinformatics在线获取。

papers.title: Fermentation of mulberry leaf extract by Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1 for flavor improvement and enhanced hypoglycemic activity.
papers.authors: Li, Xuezhen; He, Fatao; Lv, Xuqiang; Ma, Yanrui; Meng, Yuan; Lu, Xueyao; Zhao, Yan; Tian, Jiewei; Liu, Guangpeng; Wu, Maoyu
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究桑叶提取物经真菌发酵改善风味和降糖活性，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
papers.abstract: Mulberry leaf extract (MLE) is rich in bioactive compounds with potent hypoglycemic activity, but is constrained by its sensory drawbacks. In this study, Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1, isolated from Fu brick tea, was employed to ferment MLE for improving both its flavor profile and functional efficacy. Fermentation dynamically remodeled MLE composition: total phenolic acids decreased from 859.8 to 566.5 mg/mL, while total amino acid content increased dramatically from 322.13 mg/mL to 570.31 mg/mL with methionine and cysteine increased by 111.5-fold and 5.4-fold, respectively. The content of 1-deoxynojirimycin (1-DNJ) remained stable (0.27-0.29 mg/g). Headspace-gas chromatography-ion mobility spectrometry (HS-GC-IMS) analysis identified 62 volatile compounds, revealing a reduction in bitter/astringent notes (2,3,5-trimethylpyrazine, butyric acid, etc.) and an increase in compounds associated with fruity and sweet aromas (d-3-hexanone, 2,3-dimethylpyrazine etc.). Furthermore, the fermented MLE (FMLE) exhibited significantly enhanced in vitro antioxidant activity and inhibitory effects on alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase. In a zebrafish hyperglycemia model, FMLE showed lower acute toxicity (LC(1) = 1109 mug/mL vs. 609 mug/mL for MLE) and superior efficacy in promoting pancreatic glucose uptake in a dose-dependent manner. Transcriptomic and QPCR analyses elucidated that FMLE's hypoglycemic mechanism involves regulation of key genes (fut9d, irg1l, mmp9, gck) implicated in glucose metabolism and immune response. These findings demonstrate that fermentation with A. chevalieri effectively alleviates the sensory limitations of MLE while enhancing its hypoglycemic potency and biocompatibility, providing a scientific basis for its use in functional foods and nutraceuticals.
papers.abstract_zh: 桑叶提取物（MLE）富含具有强效降糖活性的生物活性化合物，但其感官缺陷限制了其应用。本研究利用从茯砖茶中分离的 Aspergillus chevalieri CTCF-AC-1 发酵 MLE，以改善其风味特征和功能功效。发酵动态重塑了 MLE 的组成：总酚酸从 859.8 mg/mL 降至 566.5 mg/mL，而总氨基酸含量从 322.13 mg/mL 显著增加至 570.31 mg/mL，其中蛋氨酸和半胱氨酸分别增加了 111.5 倍和 5.4 倍。1-脱氧野尻霉素（1-DNJ）含量保持稳定（0.27-0.29 mg/g）。顶空气相色谱-离子迁移谱（HS-GC-IMS）分析鉴定出 62 种挥发性化合物，显示苦味/涩味相关化合物（2,3,5-三甲基吡嗪、丁酸等）减少，而果香和甜香相关化合物（d-3-己酮、2,3-二甲基吡嗪等）增加。此外，发酵 MLE（FMLE）表现出显著增强的体外抗氧化活性以及对 α-淀粉酶和 α-葡萄糖苷酶的抑制效果。在斑马鱼高血糖模型中，FMLE 显示出较低的急性毒性（LC(1) = 1109 μg/mL，而 MLE 为 609 μg/mL），并以剂量依赖方式促进胰腺葡萄糖摄取，表现出更优功效。转录组和 QPCR 分析阐明，FMLE 的降糖机制涉及调节与葡萄糖代谢和免疫反应相关的关键基因（fut9d、irg1l、mmp9、gck）。这些发现表明，A. chevalieri 发酵有效缓解了 MLE 的感官限制，同时增强了其降糖效力和生物相容性，为其在功能食品和营养保健品中的应用提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Nanoliposomal curcumin as a potential pro-apoptotic agent for cervical cancer: Evidence from Bcl-2 and Bax modulation in HeLa cells.
papers.authors: Subandi, Subandi; Aisyah, Oktalia N; Lestari, Bayu
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究纳米脂质体姜黄素对宫颈癌细胞凋亡蛋白Bcl-2/Bax的调控，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
papers.abstract: Cervical cancer remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality, and treatment effectiveness is often limited by drug resistance and systemic toxicity. Curcumin has shown anticancer activity, but its clinical translation is constrained by poor solubility and low bioavailability. Nanoliposomal curcumin (Cur-NLPs) may improve intracellular delivery; however, its dose-dependent effect on apoptosis-related proteins in cervical cancer cells remains insufficiently defined. This study evaluated the dose-dependent modulation of Bcl-2 and Bax protein expression by Cur-NLPs in HeLa cells. HeLa cells were assigned to five groups: negative control, cisplatin 5 microg/mL as positive control, and Cur-NLPs at 100, 150, and 200 microg/mL. After 24 hours of treatment, Bcl-2 and Bax expression were assessed by immunofluorescence and quantified as corrected total cell fluorescence (CTCF). Data were analyzed using one-way ANOVA, Tukey HSD post hoc test, Pearson correlation, and linear regression. Significant between-group differences were observed for both Bcl-2 (F=8.99; p=0.002) and Bax (F=132.38; p<0.001). Cur-NLPs progressively reduced Bcl-2 expression and increased Bax expression, with the most pronounced effect observed at 200 microg/mL. Bcl-2 expression at 200 microg/mL and Bax expression at 150-200 microg/mL were significantly altered compared with the negative control, while the 200 microg/mL dose showed no significant difference from cisplatin for either marker. Cur-NLPs concentration showed a strong negative correlation with Bcl-2 expression (r=-0.847; p<0.001) and a strong positive correlation with Bax expression (r=0.942; p<0.001). Linear regression further confirmed dose-dependent effects, with Cur-NLPs concentration explaining 79.6% and 88.8% of the variance in Bcl-2 and Bax expression, respectively. These findings indicate that Cur-NLPs can shift the Bcl-2/Bax balance toward a pro-apoptotic profile in HeLa cells, supporting its potential as a curcumin-based nanodelivery strategy for cervical cancer. Further studies using functional apoptosis assays, additional cervical cancer cell lines, and in vivo models are needed to confirm its translational relevance.
papers.abstract_zh: 宫颈癌仍然是癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，而治疗效果常受限于耐药性和全身毒性。姜黄素（curcumin）已显示出抗癌活性，但其临床转化受制于溶解性差和生物利用度低。纳米脂质体姜黄素（nanoliposomal curcumin, Cur-NLPs）可能改善细胞内递送；然而，其对宫颈癌细胞中凋亡相关蛋白的剂量依赖性效应仍未得到充分定义。本研究评估了Cur-NLPs在HeLa细胞中对Bcl-2和Bax蛋白表达的剂量依赖性调节作用。HeLa细胞被分为五组：阴性对照组、顺铂（cisplatin）5微克/毫升作为阳性对照组，以及Cur-NLPs 100、150和200微克/毫升组。处理24小时后，通过免疫荧光（immunofluorescence）评估Bcl-2和Bax表达，并量化为校正总细胞荧光（corrected total cell fluorescence, CTCF）。数据采用单因素方差分析（one-way ANOVA）、Tukey HSD事后检验、Pearson相关分析和线性回归进行分析。Bcl-2（F=8.99；p=0.002）和Bax（F=132.38；p<0.001）均观察到显著的组间差异。Cur-NLPs逐渐降低Bcl-2表达并增加Bax表达，在200微克/毫升时观察到最显著的效果。与阴性对照组相比，200微克/毫升时的Bcl-2表达和150-200微克/毫升时的Bax表达显著改变，而200微克/毫升剂量在两种标志物上与顺铂相比均无显著差异。Cur-NLPs浓度与Bcl-2表达呈强负相关（r=-0.847；p<0.001），与Bax表达呈强正相关（r=0.942；p<0.001）。线性回归进一步确认了剂量依赖性效应，Cur-NLPs浓度分别解释了Bcl-2和Bax表达变异的79.6%和88.8%。这些发现表明，Cur-NLPs能在HeLa细胞中将Bcl-2/Bax平衡转向促凋亡特征，支持其作为基于姜黄素的纳米递送策略用于宫颈癌的潜力。未来需采用功能性凋亡检测、更多宫颈癌细胞系和体内模型进行进一步研究，以确认其转化相关性。

papers.title: Selective control of HLA-DRB1 and HLA-DQA1 transcription through DR/DQ super enhancer microelements.
papers.authors: Majumder, Parimal; Lee, Joshua; Butler, Royce; Scharer, Christopher D; Boss, Jeremy M
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究MHC-II基因的转录调控，与cpcdh基因家族无关，但涉及基因表达调控机制可借鉴。
papers.abstract: MHC-II gene expression requires promoter-proximal and distal organizing elements. A super enhancer located between the HLA-DR and -DQ genes was dissected into five microdomains (regions A-E) to define its mechanism of action. Regions A and B were required for maximal expression of HLA-DQA1. Region A facilitated HLA-DQA1 expression and substituted for region B in its absence, as well as mediating longer-range interactions with distal CTCF sites. Region D modulated HLA-DRB1 through specific 3D chromatin interactions, whereas a local insulator element (XL9) broadly interacted with the SE. Through deletion of HLA-DRB1 proximal-promoter elements, HLA-DQ expression increased by co-opting interactions with region D, indicating that competition between microelements regulates the absolute levels of MHC-II genes. Together, these data define an additional layer of control for MHC-II genes encoded in one of the most polymorphic and disease-associated regions of the human genome.
papers.abstract_zh: MHC-II基因表达需要启动子近端和远端的组织元件。位于HLA-DR和-DQ基因之间的超级增强子被分解为五个微结构域（区域A-E），以明确其作用机制。区域A和B是HLA-DQA1最大表达所必需的。区域A促进HLA-DQA1表达，并在区域B缺失时替代其功能，同时介导与远端CTCF位点的更长程相互作用。区域D通过特定的3D染色质相互作用调节HLA-DRB1，而一个局部绝缘子元件（XL9）与SE广泛相互作用。通过删除HLA-DRB1近端启动子元件，HLA-DQ表达通过共选区域D的相互作用而增加，表明微元件之间的竞争调节MHC-II基因的绝对水平。综合来看，这些数据定义了人类基因组中一个最具多态性和疾病关联区域中编码的MHC-II基因的额外调控层。

papers.title: Genetic mechanisms of mitotic error in 840,853 blood genomes
papers.authors: Si Y; Kamitaki N; Tang D; Loh P
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究血液基因组中嵌合非整倍体的遗传机制，与cpcdh基因家族无关。
papers.abstract: Mosaic aneuploidies in leukocytes are commonly detectable in aging individuals. Here, we studied inherited genetic influences on susceptibility to such aneuploidies by precisely quantifying chromosomal ploidy from whole-genome sequencing read-depth in 840,853 individuals. This approach revealed autosomal gains in ∼70,000 individuals (7-fold more than previous data sets) and ubiquitous loss of the X chromosome in females and loss of Y in males, each of which exhibited > 50% heritability. Genome-wide association analyses of 12 mosaic aneuploidies identified > 800 common inherited influences on the generation and proliferation of aneuploid cells. Variants in mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint genes consistently affected aneuploidy of most chromosomes, whereas a missense variant in PMF1 (which encodes a subunit of the outer kinetochore) associated with increased segregation fidelity of some chromosomes at the expense of others. Structural variation within multiple chromosomes associated with allele-specific effects on missegregation rates. An inherited hybrid centromere formed by an ancient recombination of 22q with 13p—generating the largest common structural variant in the human genome—associated with 4-fold greater risk of chromosome 22 gain. Abundant copy number and sequence variation in two X-linked CTCF-binding repeat arrays, ICCE and DXZ4 , associated with a 4-fold range in the likelihoods of different X chromosomes to be lost. These results show how genetic risk of chromosomal gains and losses varies greatly across chromosomes and across people, providing instruments for assessing the effects of mosaic aneuploidies on health.
papers.abstract_zh: 白细胞中的嵌合体非整倍体（mosaic aneuploidies）在衰老个体中普遍可检测到。本研究通过精确量化840,853名个体的全基因组测序读深（whole-genome sequencing read-depth）中的染色体倍性（chromosomal ploidy），探讨了遗传因素对此类非整倍体易感性的影响。该方法揭示了约70,000名个体中的常染色体获得（autosomal gains）（比以往数据集多7倍），以及女性中X染色体的普遍缺失和男性中Y染色体的普遍缺失，每种情况均表现出>50%的遗传度（heritability）。对12种嵌合体非整倍体的全基因组关联分析（genome-wide association analyses）识别出>800个影响非整倍体细胞生成与增殖的常见遗传因素。有丝分裂纺锤体组装检查点（mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint）基因的变异一致地影响大多数染色体的非整倍体，而PMF1（编码外动粒（outer kinetochore）亚基）中的一个错义变异（missense variant）与某些染色体分离保真度（segregation fidelity）的增加相关，但以其他染色体的保真度为代价。多个染色体内的结构变异（structural variation）与错误分离率（missegregation rates）的等位基因特异性效应（allele-specific effects）相关。一个由22q与13p的古老重组形成的遗传性杂合着丝粒（inherited hybrid centromere）——产生了人类基因组中最大的常见结构变异——与染色体22获得的风险增加4倍相关。两个X连锁的CTCF结合重复序列阵列（CTCF-binding repeat arrays）ICCE和DXZ4中的丰富拷贝数变异（copy number variation）和序列变异（sequence variation），与不同X染色体丢失可能性的4倍范围相关。这些结果表明，染色体获得与丢失的遗传风险在不同染色体之间以及不同个体之间差异巨大，为评估嵌合体非整倍体对健康的影响提供了工具。

papers.title: A lipoprotein-responsive circular RNA, circCTCF, couples extracellular lipid availability to mTOR signaling via ACSL5 in triple-negative breast cancer.
papers.authors: Zhang, Yuanyuan; Liu, Zhengyi; Su, Xuanyi; Hu, Xinyuan; Zhang, Qing; Zhang, Huiyang; Shicao, Duan; Cheng, Linna; Zhang, Xu Dong; Liu, Xiaoying; Chen, Song; Thorne, Rick F
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究circCTCF在乳腺癌中调控脂质代谢和mTOR信号，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
papers.abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive subtype with limited therapeutic options. While metabolic reprogramming is a hallmark of cancer, most studies have focused on cell-intrinsic alterations in glucose and amino acid metabolism, with comparatively little attention paid to how cancer cells sense and respond to extracellular lipid availability. Here, through an unbiased transcriptomic and circRNA profiling screen under lipoprotein-deprived conditions, we identify circCTCF, a circular RNA derived from the CTCF gene, as a lipoprotein-responsive regulator of lipid metabolism and proliferation in TNBC. circCTCF is significantly downregulated upon lipid withdrawal, and its depletion impairs cell growth while promoting lipid droplet accumulation. Conversely, circCTCF overexpression enhances proliferation and suppresses lipid storage. Mechanistically, circCTCF binds the RNA-binding protein G3BP2 through its back-splice junction sequence to stabilize ACSL5 mRNA, thereby sustaining ACSL5 expression, phosphatidic acid (PA) levels, and mTOR signaling. ACSL5 overexpression rescues PA and mTOR activity in circCTCF-deficient cells, establishing a linear circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR axis. Furthermore, circCTCF associates with G3BP2-positive stress granules upon heat shock, suggesting a potential link between this metabolic axis and stress-induced RNA regulatory networks. Collectively, these findings establish circCTCF as a critical node coupling extracellular lipid cues to intracellular metabolic control and identify the circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR axis as a potential therapeutic vulnerability in TNBC.
papers.abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（triple-negative breast cancer, TNBC）是一种侵袭性亚型，治疗选择有限。尽管代谢重编程是癌症的一个标志，但大多数研究聚焦于葡萄糖和氨基酸代谢的细胞内在改变，相对较少关注癌细胞如何感知和响应细胞外脂质可用性。在此，通过在脂蛋白剥夺条件下进行无偏转录组和circRNA谱筛选，我们鉴定出circCTCF——一种源自CTCF基因的环状RNA——作为TNBC中脂质代谢和增殖的脂蛋白响应性调控因子。circCTCF在脂质剥夺后显著下调，其缺失会损害细胞生长，同时促进脂滴积累。相反，circCTCF过表达增强增殖并抑制脂质储存。机制上，circCTCF通过其反向剪接连接序列结合RNA结合蛋白G3BP2，以稳定ACSL5 mRNA，从而维持ACSL5表达、磷脂酸（phosphatidic acid, PA）水平和mTOR信号传导。ACSL5过表达可恢复circCTCF缺陷细胞中的PA和mTOR活性，建立一条线性的circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR轴。此外，circCTCF在热休克下与G3BP2阳性应激颗粒结合，提示该代谢轴与应激诱导的RNA调控网络之间存在潜在联系。总体而言，这些发现确立了circCTCF作为耦合细胞外脂质信号与细胞内代谢控制的关键节点，并确定circCTCF-ACSL5-PA-mTOR轴是TNBC中一个潜在的治疗脆弱点。

papers.title: Allele-specific chromatin architecture shapes imprinted domains and coordinates a distal enhancer and antisense transcription at the mouse Mest-Copg2 domain.
papers.authors: Bae, Bongmin; Gu, Katherine; Loftus, Daniel; Whipple, Amanda J
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究小鼠Mest-Copg2印记域中等位基因特异性染色质结构如何调控印记表达，虽未直接研究cpcdh基因家族，但提供了印记调控机制和染色质构象分析的重要借鉴。
papers.abstract: Genomic imprinting results in parent-of-origin-dependent gene expression, but how three-dimensional genome organization contributes to imprinted gene regulation remains unclear. Using Capture Hi-C in mouse cortex and primary cortical neurons, we identified parental allele-specific chromatin architectures across multiple imprinted domains. These architectures largely originate from imprinting control regions and correlate with DNA methylation-sensitive CTCF binding. Active and inactive alleles of imprinted genes show distinct promoter interaction profiles and differential engagement with distal regulatory elements in both contact frequency and the epigenetic state of distal regions. A CRISPR interference screen identified a distal enhancer that regulates Mest-Copg2 imprinted expression through allele-specific chromatin interactions. In neurons, this enhancer activates Copg2 on the maternal allele, whereas on the paternal allele it drives Mest isoforms transcribed antisense to Copg2 and contributes to Copg2 repression. In summary, we show that allele-specific chromatin architecture coordinates maternal enhancer activity and paternal antisense transcription to control imprinted expression in neurons.
papers.abstract_zh: 基因组印记导致基因表达具有亲本来源依赖性，但三维基因组组织如何参与印记基因调控仍不清楚。通过在小鼠皮层和原代皮层神经元中应用Capture Hi-C技术，我们鉴定了多个印记结构域中亲本等位基因特异性的染色质结构。这些结构主要起源于印记控制区，并与DNA甲基化敏感的CTCF结合相关。印记基因的活性等位基因与非活性等位基因在启动子相互作用谱上存在差异，并且在接触频率和远端区域的表观遗传状态方面，与远端调控元件的差异参与程度也不同。CRISPR干扰筛选鉴定出一个远端增强子，该增强子通过等位基因特异性的染色质相互作用调控Mest-Copg2印记表达。在神经元中，该增强子在母本等位基因上激活Copg2，而在父本等位基因上则驱动与Copg2反义转录的Mest异构体，并参与Copg2的抑制。总之，我们证明等位基因特异性的染色质结构协调母本增强子活性和父本反义转录，从而控制神经元中的印记表达。

papers.title: Preliminary analysis of chromatin accessibility in osteosarcoma tissues.
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究通过ATAC-seq分析骨肉瘤染色质可及性，关注AP-1家族转录因子，与cpcdh基因家族无直接关联。
papers.abstract: Osteosarcoma (OS) is highly invasive, metastatic, and lacks effective therapies, leading to poor prognosis. This study aims to dissect the core epigenetic features of OS from the perspective of chromatin accessibility to elucidate its pathogenesis and identify novel therapeutic targets. ATAC-seq was used to map the global chromatin accessibility profiles of OS tissues versus normal controls. We identified OS-specific aberrantly accessible chromatin regions and delineated enriched transcription factor binding motifs. Key transcription factors were validated by Western blotting and flow cytometry. Notably, in regions with enhanced accessibility, the binding probability of AP-1 family members (including Atf3, Fra1, Fra2, JunB, BATF, AP-1, Jun-AP1, Bach2, and CTCF) was significantly elevated. Further analysis indicates that JunB can inhibit apoptosis of OS cells and enhance their invasive ability, suggesting that it may be related to tumor progression. Overall, JunB, as a candidate molecule with potential research value, is worthy of further verification in subsequent in vivo models and clinical samples to determine its feasibility as an intervention target for OS.
papers.abstract_zh: 骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）具有高度侵袭性、转移性，且缺乏有效疗法，导致预后不良。本研究旨在从染色质可及性（chromatin accessibility）角度解析OS的核心表观遗传特征，以阐明其发病机制并发现新的治疗靶点。采用ATAC-seq技术绘制OS组织与正常对照的全局染色质可及性图谱。我们鉴定了OS特异性异常可及的染色质区域，并描绘了富集的转录因子结合基序。通过Western blotting和流式细胞术验证了关键转录因子。值得注意的是，在可及性增强的区域中，AP-1家族成员（包括Atf3、Fra1、Fra2、JunB、BATF、AP-1、Jun-AP1、Bach2和CTCF）的结合概率显著升高。进一步分析表明，JunB可抑制OS细胞凋亡并增强其侵袭能力，提示其可能与肿瘤进展相关。总体而言，JunB作为具有潜在研究价值的候选分子，值得在后续体内模型和临床样本中进一步验证，以确定其作为OS干预靶点的可行性。

papers.title: CTCF aligns single-cell TAD-like domain boundaries and stabilizes long-range active chromatin clusters.
papers.authors: Chen, Ziyin; Li, Xuan; Dai, Yunpeng; Shao, Kaiwen; Sun, Haolun; Wu, Nan; Yan, Jian; Zhang, Yanxiao; Yu, Miao
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单细胞HiRES技术揭示CTCF缺失如何影响TAD边界稳定性和长距离活性染色质簇，与cpcdh基因家族在染色质结构调控中的潜在角色高度相关。
papers.abstract: CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) is a key architectural protein in the three-dimensional (3D) genome, yet how its loss reshapes chromatin structure and transcription at single-cell resolution remains unclear. Using HiRES, which jointly profiles chromatin contacts and RNA from the same nucleus, we examined genome-wide effects of CTCF depletion. Topologically associating domain (TAD)-like domains (TLDs) across single cells remained largely unchanged in number and size after CTCF loss, but their boundaries became more variably positioned, and pseudobulk analyses revealed reduced interactions within A compartments. We also developed SALTAFinder to identify Spatially Aggregated Long-distance TLD Assemblies (SALTAs), clusters of TLDs occupying shared 3D space within single cells. A subset of SALTAs is enriched for highly expressed genes and super-enhancers and declines upon CTCF depletion. This structural reorganization coincided with a global reduction in per-cell RNA output, as indicated by HiRES and orthogonal measurements. Together, these findings suggest that CTCF contributes to the coordinated regulation of chromatin organization and transcriptional capacity and is associated with stabilization of long-range active chromatin clusters.
papers.abstract_zh: CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）是三维（3D）基因组中的关键结构蛋白，但其缺失如何在单细胞分辨率下重塑染色质结构和转录仍不清楚。利用HiRES（HiRES）技术，该技术可同时从同一细胞核中分析染色质接触和RNA，我们研究了CTCF缺失的全基因组效应。在CTCF缺失后，单细胞中的拓扑关联结构域（TAD）样结构域（TLD）在数量和大小上基本保持不变，但其边界位置变得更加可变，且伪批量分析显示A区室内的相互作用减少。我们还开发了SALTAFinder（SALTAFinder）来识别空间聚集的长距离TLD组装体（SALTA），即单细胞中共享3D空间的TLD簇。部分SALTA富集了高表达基因和超级增强子，并在CTCF缺失后减少。这种结构重组与每个细胞RNA输出的整体下降同时发生，如HiRES和正交测量所示。综合来看，这些发现表明CTCF有助于染色质组织和转录能力的协调调控，并与长距离活性染色质簇的稳定化相关。
